gitCommit.subject: fix(ci): remove unused var and indexes tooltip, add local dev mongo
gitCommit.body:
fix(ci): remove unused var and indexes tooltip, add local dev mongo

Drop the unused `scrollBeforeLoad` assignment that made lint exit 1 on
`e2e/tests/ui/savedMix.spec.ts`, and remove the hover tooltip from the CBS
indexes strip so the bar no longer renders `role="tooltip"` for those feeds.

Also add a local-dev MongoDB helper (`npm run dev:db`) for machines whose
network blocks Atlas port 27017, with its data directory git-ignored.

Verified locally: `npm run lint`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` all exit 0;
the flagged e2e file passes 20/20.
